## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

#### Why Premcem for Regular & Fast Hydrating Guar Gum?
* [[Check]][29]
  
  #### [Ethical Business Practices][30]
  
  We are renowned and trusted for our reliability, transparency and integrity, irrespective of
  market movements such as those in 2011-12, and hence we have been a [supplier of choice][31] for
  multinational corporations for over 65 years.
* #### [Stringent Quality Control][32]
  
  We are committed to consistently delivering high-quality products that meet or exceed customer
  specifications and we have implemented a [QA System][33] that enables us to meet this objective.
  Our manufacturing facilities are FSSC 22000, Kosher, Halal, FSSAI Certified.
* #### [LATEST MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGY][34]
  
  All the latest innovations in the field of Fast Hydrating Guar have been incorporated in our [new
  production facility][35] which was commissioned in 2013. This includes processes such as
  double-flaking and also processes to be able to supply material with low slurry viscosities.
* #### [Experienced Management][36]
  
  We are ably lead by [Mr. Premal Joisher][37], Chairman and Managing Director, who between them
  have more than 70 years of experience in the Guar Gum business.
* #### [OPTIMAL LOCATION][38]
  
  Our [Gandhidham site][39], which houses our newest and largest production facility and 81,000 sq
  ft of warehousing area, is located on India’s National Highway 8A. It is a mere 15 km from Kandla
  Port, and just 100 km from the state-of-the-art Mundra Port, making it ideal for export shipments.
* #### [SMETA 4 Audited & Certified][40]
  
  We are [SMETA 4 audited and certified][41], for Labour Standards, Health & Safety, Environment and
  Business Ethics by [Sedex][42]. Sedex registered customers can connect with us on the Sedex portal
  and can access our Sedex reports online.
* #### Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Registered
  
  We are [Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Registered][43].

#### Our Product Range

In addition to Guar Gum, our product range includes Cassia Gum, Gum Ghatti, Psyllium Husk, Tamarind
Kernel Powder. What began with exporting undehusked splits to developed markets, where Guar Gum had
already been identified for its application in the processed food, textile and oil-well drilling
industries, is today a technology and process-driven full-scale manufacturing company. We have
steadily moved up the value-chain from undehusked Guar splits to dehusked Guar splits to Fast
Hydrating Guar.

#### Our Periodontists Have Pursued Leadership & Scholarship In Dentistry

Periodontists receive three additional years of post-graduate training after four years of dental
school to become specialists. Additionally, periodontists who achieve board certification with the 
American Board of Periodontology have passed rigorous written, oral, and practicum examinations
given by its Board of Examiners to achieve board certification known as Diplomate status. 
Furthermore, to retain Diplomate status, the periodontist must fulfill approved continuing education
requirements throughout their career. 

Bryan M. Siegelman, DDS has been a Diplomate since 1989. He served as the Periodontal and Dental
Implant Director for Wellspan Health's dental residency program for over three decades.  Dr.
Siegelman was elected and served on the American Academy of Periodontology’s National Board of
Trustees for six years, a testament to the respect he has attained from practitioners and scholars
in the profession.

Sarah Pham, DDS, MS has been a Diplomate since May 2024.

 

Both practitioners are members of the American Academy of Periodontology (AAP). The AAP’s mission is
to advance the oral and general health of the public and promote excellence in the practice of
periodontics. Visit their website for more information: www.perio.org

# Periodontal & Implant Center of York

> Why Do You Need A Periodontist?
> (Terms that are underlined can be clicked on for further information)

More than ***half of Americans over the age of 30*** have gum disease known as periodontitis.
Symptoms include loose teeth, inflamed, receding or bleeding gums, and/or chronically bad breath.
Recent studies have found that if left untreated, the disease can lead to tooth loss, and other
conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, Alzheimer’s disease, cancers, and low birth
weight in a newborn. Periodontics is one of the nine dental specialties recognized by the American
Dental Association (ADA). ***Periodontists are the only healthcare providers* who are specialty
trained to treat the above-mentioned oral conditions**.

Our practice offers comprehensive periodontal care including treatment of gum disease
(periodontitis) to save natural teeth, the placement of dental implants when natural teeth can no
longer be saved, tissue grafting to treat gum recession, and cosmetic periodontal surgery to improve
the smile aesthetic.

The office is located in the **Brockie Medical Center, 924-G Colonial Avenue, York, PA**.

Call **[York Office Phone Number 717-845-6687][80]** with questions or to make an appointment.

exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique

guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from

# Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499

Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499 is the purified version of Cassia Gum technical / petfood grade
E499. The plant derives from a wild crop that grows in most parts of central India as a weed. The
Cassia Gum Powder is produced from the endosperms of Senna obtusifolia also called Cassia Tora L. /
Cassia obtusifolia L.

Nowadays, **main applications** are in
* petfood,
* food,
* personal care and
* pharmaceutical products.

Learn more about the [origin][21], typical [applications][22] and [quality | certificates][23] at
the next pages or get in contact with us directly.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][24]

Historically Cassia Gum was developed as a cheaper alternative to Locust Bean Gum (LBG) for the pet
food industry. The first Cassia Gum product was the so called Technical Grade or Pet Food Grade.
Throughout the years this product found a firm and stable place in this industry. Driven by
innovation and to make the product even safer and suitable for use in other industries the
production process and washing was refined consequently.

Finally, Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499 is the new standard for pet food and food applications
since the end of 2019.

[Cassia Gum Food Grade from India]

## Origin

### Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499

Main Origin of the raw material for Cassia Gum Food Grade, which is made from the seeds of wild
growing Cassia Obtusifolia and Cassia Tora, is in central regions of India. Namely in the states of
Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.

The seeds can also be found in other regions of the world like Australia, USA or South East Asia.

However, the source for our Cassia Gum Food Grade comes from the “heart and soul” which is and
remains the centre of India with plenty of the raw materials available on reasonable volumes and
also qualities.

### Safety of product and supply

The manufacturer we deal with is in this business since the 1990’s. You can be sure to have a safe
product and secured supply chain, as they are very familiar with the whole business and spanned a
broad network to farmers and wholesalers all over the sourcing areas that are available.

Depending on Monsoon, where it comes down and to which extend, we can always access and secure
reasonable volumes of raw materials in the required high quality to secure your high quality
finished product.

[manufacturing Cassia Gum Food Grade from India]

## Manufacturing process

In the manufacturing process of pet food and food – Safety – is and will be one of your main
objectives.

Same for us, the focus of the final Cassia Gum Food Grade Powder is the safety of humans and pets.
The **manufacturing process of high quality Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499 requires experience
and knowledge** and that is where you benefit in a cooperation with us and partners with many years
of experience.

Our partners in Germany and India were involved in the development of the original “basic” Cassia
Gum Grade, nowadays also called “Technical Grade” or “Feed Grade”.

And, they are the inventors and innovation drivers to develop and establish the new and even better
and safer “Cassia Gum Food Grade” quality.

**Experienced staff**, which belongs to the factory since at least 20 years, **secures that each
single batch is manufactured according to the new **[**EU regulation** “concerning the authorisation
of cassia gum as a feed additive for cats and dogs” published 22nd of November 2019][25].

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][26]

## Applications of Cassia Gum Food Grade

### Pet Food

Cassia Gum Food Grade and also the former Cassia Gum Technical Grade are a substitute to Locust Bean
Gum for use in Pet Food application. Due to the very similar structure they can boost applications
using Kappa Carrageenan. Different to the combination with LBG, when using Cassia Gum Food Grade you
receive firm thermo-plastic gels.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][27]

### Food

dairy products and meat products.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

### What is  Natural Gum ?

[Natural_Gum]

###### Natural Gum Makers

Natural gum has been used by various cultures throughout history for its medicinal and recreational
properties. These gums are derived from tree sap and have been chewed long before the advent of
modern synthetic chewing gums. Natural chewing gum refers to gum made from natural ingredients,
often emphasizing sustainability and health. Unlike traditional chewing gum, which may contain
butadiene styrene and artificial sweeteners.


Starting a natural gum company offers a promising opportunity to enter a growing market with
increasing consumer demand for health, sustainability, and ethical products. By offering a product
that aligns with these values, you not only meet the needs of modern consumers but also contribute
positively to the environment and society. With the right approach, innovation, and commitment, your
natural gum company can thrive and make a meaningful impact in the world of consumer products.

# Nexira acquires Keragum

This acquisition strengthens Nexira’s position in the global natural hydrocolloids and carob market
while securing direct access to raw materials at origin, ensuring the quality, traceability, and
long-term sustainability of its supply chain.

Global leader in acacia, natural ingredients, and botanical extracts, Nexira is dedicated to provide
only the best natural and plant-based ingredients with a large offer available in organic. Discover
a unique selection of a wide range of natural ingredients gently processed into powder form with the
finest quality for the food, health and nutrition industries.

## Innovation inspired by nature

Our family-owned company has built its reputation as the world leader in acacia, a natural exudate
of acacia trees. Our expertise has expanded to encompass a large range of ingredients derived from
natural sources. Our portfolio of products includes high-quality plant extract powders,
antioxidants, soluble dietary fibers, texturizing ingredients, and active botanical extracts.

Nexira’s 3 complementary divisions ensure a global expertise from raw material sourcing and
proprietary processing technologies to formulation support.

# **What We Do | Tablet & Gum Manufacturer **

## Leading the Way in Unique Tableted Products

[Gum Manufacturer in Maryland]

Per Os Bio is a manufacturer located in Maryland that specializes in developing and manufacturing
tableted products that provide faster absorption of [active ingredients][31] – chewing gum, lozenges
and chewable tablets (We are the #1 functional gum manufacturer in the US).  Tableted chewing gum is
a delivery system where most of the active ingredients are absorbed through the [buccal mucosa][32],
under the tongue, (the rest is swallowed like an ingested product), which is faster (and more
bio-available) than products that use conventional oral absorption in tablet, capsule or liquid
dosage forms through the [gastrointestinal tract][33].

As a gum manufacturer we are one of very few gum manufacturing companies in the world that has
the ability to make functional chewing gum products – and the only functional gum manufacturer in
the United States.  Our functional chewing gum is made using a [patented][34] process of adding
active ingredients to a powdered gum base and then tableting a chewing gum using direct compression,
thus making a product that has content uniformity from piece to piece.  Unlike other companies that
make chewing gum products, we are the only gum manufacturing company that manufactures its own
powdered gum base using our proprietary, patent-pending process.  This process allows us the
flexibility to create custom chewing gum formulations.  Conventional chewing gum manufacturers use a
high temperature extruded process that can destroy the active ingredients, which may result in a
sub-potent final product.   As a gum manufacturer our chewing gum is manufactured under
FDA-regulated GMP conditions at room temperature so the actives are fully available in the final
product.

 

[Gum manufacturing plant]
[Gum production machine]

We make tableted products in a variety of dosage forms for a diverse customer base, and for domestic
and international markets. Per Os Bio actually manufactures functional chewing gum products in its
own 28,000 sq ft facility and is not a broker without its own factory.  We contract manufacture or
private label tableted chewing gum, chew-able tablets, lozenges, mints and candy for a wide variety
of customers including national brand leaders, small niche marketers, the U.S. Military, export
customers and many more.  Our product capabilities include dietary supplements, functional chewing
gum, medicated chewing gum, functional foods and confectionery, medicated confectionery and
compressed dextrose or sugar-free candy – almost anything that can be tableted we can make.  We
are a socially and ethically responsible company that operates a quality-driven, GMP compliant
production environment.  Our products are Kosher (Star-K) certified.

Our in-house formulation team works with customers to create unique products so let Per Os Bio
develop a product for you that will surpass your competitors in originality, effectiveness and
taste!

We develop and manufacture products in the following categories:
* dietary supplements and nutraceuticals
* functional chewing gum
* medicated chewing gum
* functional foods
* medicated confectionery

companies competing in a variety of

## **About**

[CBD-Infused Hemp Oil logo]

Per Os Bio was created in 2009 by a pharmaceutical industry executive with the goal of developing
niche healthcare products (supplements and pharmaceuticals) in underutilized, emerging dosage forms
like tableted chewing gum, chew-able tablets and lozenges.  Using an in-house product development
team, Per Os Bio develops custom tablet formulations that incorporate dietary supplements for
companies competing in a variety of

markets, including energy, immune support, weight loss and dental, just to name a few.
Per Os Bio is one of very few companies in the world that has the ability to make tableted chewing
gum products.  Per Os Bio uses a direct compression tableting process.  Our proprietary compressed
gum delivery technology is excellent for delivering supplements and active ingredients.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community
* R&D Researchers from Pharma Industries
* Directors of Organizations
* CEO's of Organizations
* Business Development Managers
* Chief Scientific Officers
* Academia
* Drug Delivery Entities
* Medical Groups
* Related Associations
* Biomedical Device Industries
* Medical Device Industries

 

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

# Welcome to Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.

**“For The Healthier Humankind”**

The definition of Actiza is “**Active zeal**”. We have an active zeal for a healthier world. Actiza
Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. has become a paradigm in pharmaceutical manufacturing, exporting, and
supplying products that meet international standards. Actiza believes in a systematic approach to

# Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499

Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499 is the purified version of Cassia Gum technical / petfood grade
E499. The plant derives from a wild crop that grows in most parts of central India as a weed. The
Cassia Gum Powder is produced from the endosperms of Senna obtusifolia also called Cassia Tora L. /
Cassia obtusifolia L.

Nowadays, **main applications** are in
* petfood,
* food,
* personal care and
* pharmaceutical products.

Learn more about the [origin][21], typical [applications][22] and [quality | certificates][23] at
the next pages or get in contact with us directly.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][24]

Historically Cassia Gum was developed as a cheaper alternative to Locust Bean Gum (LBG) for the pet
food industry. The first Cassia Gum product was the so called Technical Grade or Pet Food Grade.
Throughout the years this product found a firm and stable place in this industry. Driven by
innovation and to make the product even safer and suitable for use in other industries the
production process and washing was refined consequently.

Finally, Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499 is the new standard for pet food and food applications
since the end of 2019.

[Cassia Gum Food Grade from India]

## Origin

### Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499

Main Origin of the raw material for Cassia Gum Food Grade, which is made from the seeds of wild
growing Cassia Obtusifolia and Cassia Tora, is in central regions of India. Namely in the states of
Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.

The seeds can also be found in other regions of the world like Australia, USA or South East Asia.

However, the source for our Cassia Gum Food Grade comes from the “heart and soul” which is and
remains the centre of India with plenty of the raw materials available on reasonable volumes and
also qualities.

### Safety of product and supply

The manufacturer we deal with is in this business since the 1990’s. You can be sure to have a safe
product and secured supply chain, as they are very familiar with the whole business and spanned a
broad network to farmers and wholesalers all over the sourcing areas that are available.

Depending on Monsoon, where it comes down and to which extend, we can always access and secure
reasonable volumes of raw materials in the required high quality to secure your high quality
finished product.

[manufacturing Cassia Gum Food Grade from India]

## Manufacturing process

In the manufacturing process of pet food and food – Safety – is and will be one of your main
objectives.

Same for us, the focus of the final Cassia Gum Food Grade Powder is the safety of humans and pets.
The **manufacturing process of high quality Cassia Gum Food Grade E427 | 1f499 requires experience
and knowledge** and that is where you benefit in a cooperation with us and partners with many years
of experience.

Our partners in Germany and India were involved in the development of the original “basic” Cassia
Gum Grade, nowadays also called “Technical Grade” or “Feed Grade”.

And, they are the inventors and innovation drivers to develop and establish the new and even better
and safer “Cassia Gum Food Grade” quality.

**Experienced staff**, which belongs to the factory since at least 20 years, **secures that each
single batch is manufactured according to the new **[**EU regulation** “concerning the authorisation
of cassia gum as a feed additive for cats and dogs” published 22nd of November 2019][25].

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][26]

## Applications of Cassia Gum Food Grade

### Pet Food

Cassia Gum Food Grade and also the former Cassia Gum Technical Grade are a substitute to Locust Bean
Gum for use in Pet Food application. Due to the very similar structure they can boost applications
using Kappa Carrageenan. Different to the combination with LBG, when using Cassia Gum Food Grade you
receive firm thermo-plastic gels.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][27]

### Food

Besides the use in Pet Food, Cassia finds more and more applications in the Food industry. E427 can
serve as a thickener, moisture retention agent, stabilizer, emulsifier and texturizing agent in
dairy products and meat products.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][28]

And, they are the inventors and innovation drivers to develop and establish the new and even better
and safer “Cassia Gum Food Grade” quality.

**Experienced staff**, which belongs to the factory since at least 20 years, **secures that each
single batch is manufactured according to the new **[**EU regulation** “concerning the authorisation
of cassia gum as a feed additive for cats and dogs” published 22nd of November 2019][25].

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][26]

## Applications of Cassia Gum Food Grade

### Pet Food

Cassia Gum Food Grade and also the former Cassia Gum Technical Grade are a substitute to Locust Bean
Gum for use in Pet Food application. Due to the very similar structure they can boost applications
using Kappa Carrageenan. Different to the combination with LBG, when using Cassia Gum Food Grade you
receive firm thermo-plastic gels.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][27]

### Food

Besides the use in Pet Food, Cassia finds more and more applications in the Food industry. E427 can
serve as a thickener, moisture retention agent, stabilizer, emulsifier and texturizing agent in
dairy products and meat products.

[Contact me – I want to learn more!][28]

To secure the **highest quality standards**, **proven by certificates** that are relevant to the
industry, is and always was one of our key objectives. We, our partners in Europe and India
continuously work on further improving our products and services. **Regular external and internal
audits** assure we continue to lead the market and remain at the highest possible level.

An **accredited laboratory** in Germany makes sure, that **each single batch** which is manufactured
and tested in-house is also approved by an external source. Each single batch shall and will comply
to EU/EFSA regulation stating **total Anthraquinones** content for Food Grade Cassia Gum E427 |
1f499 has to **be <0.5 mg/kg**.

lot of confident language.

reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Having presence in 65+ countries
* [icon]
  
  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

### Caffeine Anhydrous API

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like

supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

###### Natural Gum Makers

Natural gum has been used by various cultures throughout history for its medicinal and recreational
properties. These gums are derived from tree sap and have been chewed long before the advent of
modern synthetic chewing gums. Natural chewing gum refers to gum made from natural ingredients,
often emphasizing sustainability and health. Unlike traditional chewing gum, which may contain
butadiene styrene and artificial sweeteners.


Starting a natural gum company offers a promising opportunity to enter a growing market with
increasing consumer demand for health, sustainability, and ethical products. By offering a product
that aligns with these values, you not only meet the needs of modern consumers but also contribute
positively to the environment and society. With the right approach, innovation, and commitment, your

### What is  Natural Gum ?

[Natural_Gum]

###### Natural Gum Makers

Natural gum has been used by various cultures throughout history for its medicinal and recreational
properties. These gums are derived from tree sap and have been chewed long before the advent of
modern synthetic chewing gums. Natural chewing gum refers to gum made from natural ingredients,
often emphasizing sustainability and health. Unlike traditional chewing gum, which may contain
butadiene styrene and artificial sweeteners.


Starting a natural gum company offers a promising opportunity to enter a growing market with
increasing consumer demand for health, sustainability, and ethical products. By offering a product
that aligns with these values, you not only meet the needs of modern consumers but also contribute
positively to the environment and society. With the right approach, innovation, and commitment, your
natural gum company can thrive and make a meaningful impact in the world of consumer products.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

# **What We Do | Tablet & Gum Manufacturer **

## Leading the Way in Unique Tableted Products

[Gum Manufacturer in Maryland]

Per Os Bio is a manufacturer located in Maryland that specializes in developing and manufacturing
tableted products that provide faster absorption of [active ingredients][31] – chewing gum, lozenges
and chewable tablets (We are the #1 functional gum manufacturer in the US).  Tableted chewing gum is
a delivery system where most of the active ingredients are absorbed through the [buccal mucosa][32],
under the tongue, (the rest is swallowed like an ingested product), which is faster (and more
bio-available) than products that use conventional oral absorption in tablet, capsule or liquid
dosage forms through the [gastrointestinal tract][33].

As a gum manufacturer we are one of very few gum manufacturing companies in the world that has
the ability to make functional chewing gum products – and the only functional gum manufacturer in
the United States.  Our functional chewing gum is made using a [patented][34] process of adding
active ingredients to a powdered gum base and then tableting a chewing gum using direct compression,
thus making a product that has content uniformity from piece to piece.  Unlike other companies that
make chewing gum products, we are the only gum manufacturing company that manufactures its own
powdered gum base using our proprietary, patent-pending process.  This process allows us the
flexibility to create custom chewing gum formulations.  Conventional chewing gum manufacturers use a
high temperature extruded process that can destroy the active ingredients, which may result in a
sub-potent final product.   As a gum manufacturer our chewing gum is manufactured under
FDA-regulated GMP conditions at room temperature so the actives are fully available in the final
product.

 

[Gum manufacturing plant]
[Gum production machine]

We make tableted products in a variety of dosage forms for a diverse customer base, and for domestic
and international markets. Per Os Bio actually manufactures functional chewing gum products in its
own 28,000 sq ft facility and is not a broker without its own factory.  We contract manufacture or
private label tableted chewing gum, chew-able tablets, lozenges, mints and candy for a wide variety
of customers including national brand leaders, small niche marketers, the U.S. Military, export
customers and many more.  Our product capabilities include dietary supplements, functional chewing
gum, medicated chewing gum, functional foods and confectionery, medicated confectionery and
compressed dextrose or sugar-free candy – almost anything that can be tableted we can make.  We
are a socially and ethically responsible company that operates a quality-driven, GMP compliant
production environment.  Our products are Kosher (Star-K) certified.

Our in-house formulation team works with customers to create unique products so let Per Os Bio
develop a product for you that will surpass your competitors in originality, effectiveness and
taste!

We develop and manufacture products in the following categories:
* dietary supplements and nutraceuticals
* functional chewing gum
* medicated chewing gum
* functional foods
* medicated confectionery

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of

  open time. Solid bead acrylic resin grades offer excellent hardness and pigment wetting for powder

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
